parameters.family: per-ant in-lifetime circular whole-tuple phase shift
parameters.direction: null sample i = original sample (i+offset) modulo sampleCount
parameters.storage: Offsets and hash of exact virtual binary trajectory; redundant null trajectory archives are not written.
parameters.durationQuantiles: Type 7 linear interpolation; completed durations only, censor counts/elapsed kept separately
parameters.topologyAverages: All 12001 analysis samples including t=0; weighted degrees include active isolates and use pooled node-time samples
parameters.rank: Within-seed null midrank percentile = 100*(below+equal/2)/available replicates; no p-value or decision threshold
